levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than four plan parts have a role assigned, or entries are missing.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least four plan parts each have a specific role assigned.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All listed plan parts have a role assigned, with no obvious gaps.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Most or all plan parts are assigned the same generic role regardless of fit.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Roles assigned show real thought about which kind of role fits which kind of need.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner's explanation of fit references something specific about that role's actual position (for example, what a school counselor has access to that a peer doesn't).

criteria.dimension: Appropriate use of general vs. specific

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Response is incomplete because the learner treats naming a specific real person as required rather than optional.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Response is complete at whichever level (role-only or named) the learner chose, with no needless private disclosure.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Learner makes a deliberate, explained choice about which entries to keep general and which to name, rather than defaulting to one approach throughout.

lookFors: The learner is not penalized in any way for keeping entries at the role level instead of naming real people.
No real full names, contact information, or private household detail is required to complete this task.
The map covers more than one type of support (logistical, financial, emotional), not just one repeated category.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
